game.name: Karlson (Itch.io)
game.rules:
**Game Rules**

For Full Game runs, timing starts on pressing the Tutorial level and ends upon touching the milk in Sky 2. Runs must be single segment.

Levels have to be completed in the order listed on the game menu:

- Tutorial
- Sandbox 0
- Sandbox 1
- Sandbox 2
- Escape 0
- Escape 1
- Escape 2
- Escape 3
- Sky 0
- Sky 1
- Sky 2

Individual Levels are timed using the built in level timer.

**Methods of Verification**

All submissions must have at least one of the following verification methods:

1. In-Game audio turned on and audible.

2. Livesplit timer with Autosplitter (see the Guides section for help) (Only applies to full game runs).

3. Speed Indicator (MUST be turned on for Top 10 submissions, but is highly recommended for all submissions. See the Guides section for help).

4. Keyboard input display (i.e. Nohboard ( [ for download click here](https://obsproject.com/forum/resources/nohboard.44/) ) ) 

The entire game window must be visible. Do not cover the top left corner, and keep the timer/input display small or give them transparent backgrounds.

**Timing Methods**

*Windows*

Use the Livesplit Autosplitter to have your submission timed with In-Game Time (IGT), and display the timer on screen at all times. Otherwise, submissions will be timed as Real-Time Attack (RTA).

Alternatively, you may use splits.io if you have issues getting the timer on screen for the recording (See the Guides section for help).

*Linux or MacOS*

Livesplit is not available on these platforms, so runs may be timed with IGT as long as your submission has ALL of the following:

- In-Game Audio turned on and clearly audible
- In-Game Music turned on and clearly audible
- No background audio that interferes with the clarity of In-Game Audio/Music

Final decision goes to the moderation team to determine if your submission meets these standards. To be safe, please turn the volume up rather than trying to make it as quiet as possible.

**Please Note for Your Submission:**

Karlson's in-game timer displays hundredths of seconds. Be sure to enter the time correctly on your submission because Speedrun.com defaults to milliseconds (if you have a time of 13.84 in Karlson, you will need to enter 13s 840ms on your submission).

**Banned Glitches/Exploits**

Timer Bug: any method of bugging the timer to stay at 00:00.

Double Crouch: binding two crouch inputs allows you to slide while in the standing state and perform repeated crouches to gain absurd amounts of speed. (Note: spamming a single crouch input to mimic this effect is not allowed either).

Macros are not allowed. Scroll Wheel input remapping is not possible using the Vanilla key binds menu, and is essentially a macro and therefore not allowed either.

Changing the FPS cap mid-run to below 50 FPS to cause time skips is not allowed. Similarly, lag spikes that provide a severe advantage, intentional or not, is also not allowed.

relatedGames.name: Karlson (Itch.io) Category Extension
relatedGames.rules:
**Game Rules:**

For Full Game runs, timing starts on pressing the Tutorial level and ends upon touching the milk in Sky 2.  
​
Levels have to be done in the order listed in the game: 
- tut
- sb0
- sb1
- sb2
- esc0
- esc1
- esc2
- sky0
- sky1
- sky2

IGT ( in game time) is used for IL (individual level).

Using the speed indicator for all submissions is recommended, but is required for run submissions potentially in the top 10. If the player count is under 10 for a category, top3 applies.
 ( [link: how to display the in game speed](https://www.speedrun.com/karlson_itch_io/guide/q7ap1) ) )

RTA (real time attack) will be used in full runs, unless you use the autosplitter! In that case IGT is counted, but only if you use the autosplitter and display it in the video of your run.  
​
As an alternative of showing the autosplitter in the video (if you cant for some reason), you can also link to your splits on splits.io ( [click here to find out how](https://www.speedrun.com/karlson_itch.io/guide/loizl)  )  
​
Runs wont get accepted, if they don't have in game audio on. Music isn't a necessity, but is appreciated. If you cant have in game audio, you must at least have one of these:

1. handcam

2. keyboard input display (nohboard for example ( [ for download click here](https://obsproject.com/forum/resources/nohboard.44/) ) ) 

3. Speed indicator ( open the console with "tab" while you are in the game and enter "speed 1" into the command line.)

4. autosplitter ( [Autosplitter Guide here](https://www.speedrun.com/karlson_itch.io/guide/lik7n) )   Either visible in the video or splits linked on splits.io

Of course, the autosplitter is only an option, if you do full runs … it doesn't work for individual levels. Its mainly to make timing easier and verification easier , because its harder to splice a autosplitter than just a muted video. (that's also why it doesn't make sense for a IL speedrun)


You cant use the time stop glitch in any of your runs . 
(Fall into the void after you complete the level and restart with a constant 00:00 time while being able to move)

The full game window must be visible and can only be covered a little, by for example a timer. if possible, make the timer transparent or very small.

Be sure to enter the right times on speedrun.com. If you have a time of 13.84 in Karlson, you will need to enter 13.840 on speedrun.com.

Runs must be single segment.

If you want to only record the in game audio, while listening to music , then this guide might help you: [Recording only in game sound by Stöckchen](https://www.speedrun.com/karlson_itch.io/guide/41pfa)

categories.name: Double Crouch
categories.rules:
|  | **READ THE GAME RULES FIRST** |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
​

**Category Rules:**

The DC glitch (Double Crouch) is allowed and also needed . That means you need to actually use it in a run ( so people dont just submit their Any% standard runs)

Using macros to make spam easier is also allowed! You can use any auto-clicker most ppl use this one. 
​https://fabi.me/tools/speed-autoclicker

You arent allowed to uncap the fps in karlson when running dc. This means it should be at max 240fps .You also need to display your fps in the game , so we can be sure you didnt uncap it or go over 240fps.

Uncapping it can give you more crouches per second .(thus making it hardware dependent)

If you dont know how to display the fps go to this guide: https://www.speedrun.com/karlson_itch.io/guide/q7ap1

If you don't know how the glitch works watch this guide.
https://www.speedrun.com/karlson_itch.io/guide/m7cvi

categories.name: Death
categories.rules:
|  | **READ THE GAME RULES FIRST** |  |
| --- | --- | --- |


**Category Rules:**

Die in every level .

Dont skip any level and use the menu to advance to the next level.

Respawns dont count as death.

Also if you die because of falling off map, be sure to look towards the map. This will show if you simply pressed esc or if you died. Alternatively you can enable screenshaking bcs the screen only shakes if you die not if you pause.

The DC glitch (Double Crouch) isn't allowed. Any other glitch or exploit is allowed.
